notes: Parts are numbered b1..b115 in build order using the parts list. Where the manual's catalogue picture and the list were ambiguous I matched by shape and count, for example 2x2 wedge plates vs 3x2 wedge plates.

The front build treats the four 4x12 white plates as a 12 wide by 16 tall canvas. The exact stud pairings are my best reading of the isometric pictures, so treat the port-level choices as approximate.

Later face pieces (steps 14-41) are joined to the piece they sit on, but I could not resolve the exact stud, so those port numbers are approximations. The joined pairs are right; the specific ports may not be.

From step 22 the back (flip side) is built. Plates and bricks there connect with their studs into the anti-stud (underside) ports of the base plates. The 1x10 plate b59 is used as a carrier for the stand hinge plates.

The stand: red axle b67 links the two elbows b72/b73, the axles b68/b69 go into the elbows and the hinge cylinders b70/b71, and the hinge cylinders clip onto the hinge plates b64/b65 (revolute). Manual pages 49-50 show it swinging out as an easel stand.
Round feet b81-b84 are boat-stud plates whose stud goes into the open-stud round bricks b77-b80 at the four corners of the back frame.
No repeats were used because every repeated part needs its own build-order id.
